pins.title: How Much Grass Seed Do I Need? (Chart + Free Calculator)
pins.description: Find out how many pounds of grass seed your lawn needs. This chart shows seed amounts for 5,000 sq ft and 1 acre at common label rates, and the free calculator works it out for your exact lawn size and seed bag.
pins.heading: How Much Grass Seed Do I Need?
pins.sub: Seed needed = label rate × lawn area. Find your rate on the seed bag.
pins.note: Rates vary by grass type and new lawn vs. overseeding. Add about 10% extra. 1 acre = 43,560 sq ft.

pins.title: How Many Pavers Do I Need? Pavers per 100 Sq Ft Chart
pins.description: Planning a DIY paver patio or walkway? See how many pavers you need per 100 square feet for 4x8, 6x6, 12x12, 16x16 and other sizes, plus a free paver calculator with waste allowance.
pins.heading: How Many Pavers Do I Need?
pins.sub: Pavers per 100 square feet for common paver sizes.
pins.note: Example: a 10 × 10 ft patio with 16 × 16 in pavers needs 57 pavers, or 62 with 10% extra.

pins.title: How Many Fence Posts Do I Need? Fence Post Chart
pins.description: Quick fence post chart for 50 to 300 ft fences at 6 ft and 8 ft spacing. Learn the simple formula (posts = sections + 1), how to space posts evenly, and when to add posts for corners and gates.
pins.heading: How Many Fence Posts Do I Need?
pins.sub: Posts for one straight fence run. Posts = sections + 1.
pins.note: Add extra posts for corners and gates. Spacing is the maximum; posts end up evenly spaced a little closer.

pins.title: How Many Bags of Concrete for a Slab? 80 lb Bag Chart
pins.description: How many 80 lb bags of concrete for a 4 inch slab? See bag counts for common slab sizes from 4x4 to 12x12, including 10% extra, then use the free concrete bag calculator for your own size and bag yield.
pins.heading: How Many Bags of Concrete for a 4 in Slab?
pins.sub: 80 lb bags, including 10% extra for waste.
pins.note: Assumes about 0.60 cu ft per 80 lb bag. Check the yield printed on your bag.

pins.title: How Much Gravel Do I Need? Cubic Yards and Tons Chart
pins.description: Gravel chart for common areas at 3 inches deep, in cubic yards and tons. Great for planning paths, patios and gravel beds. Use the free gravel calculator to enter your own size, depth and supplier density.
pins.heading: How Much Gravel Do I Need?
pins.sub: For a 3 in deep layer, including 10% extra.
pins.note: Weight assumes 105 lb per cubic foot. Ask your supplier for their gravel density.

pins.title: How Many Deck Boards Do I Need? Deck Board Chart
pins.description: Deck board counts for common deck sizes using 5.5 in boards with 1/8 in gaps, plus linear feet with 10% extra. Use the free deck board calculator for your own deck size, board width and gap.
pins.heading: How Many Deck Boards Do I Need?
pins.sub: 5.5 in boards, 1/8 in gaps. Boards run along the deck length.
pins.note: Board count is across the deck width. Buy boards at least as long as the deck, or plan joints over joists.
